receivables.title: Receivables
receivables.subtitle: Amounts owed from claim recoveries and Friendly Settlement, payable by payment reference
receivables.emptyBody: Receivables appear when a claim recovery or a Friendly Settlement net balance is registered.

detail.title: Receivable
detail.allocationsNote: Allocations of this session; the received amount is the amount less the open balance.

receipt.title: Record a receipt
receipt.intro: The receipt is matched to the receivable by its payment reference. A partial receipt leaves the remainder open.
receipt.notPayable: The receivable does not accept receipts in its current state.

errors.amount: Enter an amount greater than zero.
errors.overOpen: The amount cannot exceed the open balance ({open}).

releases.title: Release approvals
releases.subtitle: Friendly Settlement clearing disbursements waiting for a second user to approve
releases.emptyPendingBody: Every Friendly Settlement clearing disbursement appears here for the billing manager.
releases.emptyAllBody: They appear when Friendly Settlement asks to pay out a net balance.

detail.title: Clearing release
detail.checksNote: No per-claimant verification is made; the clearing is checked as a whole.

lines.title: Claim-level lines
lines.matches: The sum of the lines equals the net amount.
lines.mismatch: The sum of the lines does not equal the net amount.
lines.mismatchBody: Sum {sum} against net {net}. Do not approve until corrected.

decision.title: Decision
decision.reasonRequired: Give a reason for the rejection.
decision.sod: You requested this release; another user must approve it (separation of duties).
decision.roleNote: Only the billing manager approves a release.
